name: android-sms-gateway
description: The SMS Gateway for Android™ app enables sending and receiving SMS messages through an API that can be accessed directly on the device or via a cloud server when direct device access is not possible.
readme_summary: The Android SMS Gateway app transforms an Android device into an SMS gateway, allowing users to send and receive SMS messages programmatically via an API. It supports features like multipart messages, message status tracking, and real-time notifications for incoming messages through webhooks.
key_features: Send and Receive SMS via API
Real-time incoming message notifications via webhooks
primary_use_case: Enabling programmatic sending and receiving of SMS messages through an API, integrating SMS functionality into other applications and services.
cover_image_prompt: A smartphone acting as a central hub, with digital streams of text messages flowing in and out. One stream transforms into a glowing API icon, representing outgoing messages being sent programmatically. Another stream, originating from a cloud icon, represents incoming messages being received and then displayed as notifications on a small, integrated screen on the phone. The phone itself has subtle circuit board patterns. The background is a clean, modern interface with abstract data visualizations. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a bright, tech-focused color palette, emphasizing connectivity and seamless communication.

name: ClovaLink
description: A modern Rust-powered, multi-tenant file storage architecture with secure APIs, extensible metadata patterns, external identity providers, and pluggable storage backends (S3, Wasabi, Local volumes). Perfect for enterprise self-hosting
readme_summary: ClovaLink is a self-hostable, multi-tenant file management platform built with Rust and React, designed to offer enterprise-grade features at a significantly lower cost than commercial solutions. It provides secure APIs, extensible metadata, external identity provider integration, and pluggable storage backends, making it ideal for businesses seeking control over their data and compliance.
key_features: Cost-effective alternative to per-user SaaS solutions
primary_use_case: Providing a secure, cost-effective, and self-hostable enterprise file management solution for businesses that require advanced features and full data control, especially those managing multiple clients or tenants.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old owl perched atop a stack of securely locked digital vaults, meticulously organizing and categorizing glowing data streams. The owl uses its keen eyes to sort information into distinct, labeled chambers, representing multi-tenancy and secure file management. Below, a small, cost-effective VPS server hums quietly, powering the operation, contrasted with a distant, expensive-looking skyscraper representing traditional enterprise solutions. Subtle lines of code and data flow around the owl, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, organized composition and a color palette of blues, greens, and subtle gold accents, emphasizing security and efficiency. The repository name 'ClovaLink' is subtly etched on one of the vaults.

name: ESP32-Bit-Pirate
description: A Hardware Hacking Tool with Web-Based CLI That Speaks Every Protocol
readme_summary: ESP32 Bit Pirate is an open-source firmware that transforms an ESP32 device into a versatile hardware hacking and analysis tool. It supports a wide array of digital and radio protocols, offering features like sniffing, sending, scripting, and interactive control via a web-based CLI.
key_features: Multi-protocol support (I2C, SPI, UART, 1-Wire, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, RFID, etc.)
Interactive command-line interface (CLI) via USB Serial or WiFi Web
primary_use_case: Hardware hacking, debugging, and analysis of various digital and radio communication protocols.
cover_image_prompt: A highly detailed, 3D isometric illustration of a central, stylized 'ESP32 Bit Pirate' device resembling a futuristic, multi-faceted compass. From its various ports, ethereal streams of data flow out, connecting to and interacting with diverse icons representing different communication protocols: a stylized Wi-Fi symbol, a Bluetooth logo, a CAN bus connector, an RFID card, and a radio wave. The device itself glows with an internal light, and small, holographic screens around it display snippets of code and protocol data. The background is a clean, dark workshop with subtle circuit board patterns. The overall mood is one of powerful, accessible technological exploration and control.

name: textual-web
description: Run TUIs and terminals in your browser
readme_summary: Textual Web allows users to run and share Textual applications and terminals directly in their web browser. It bridges the gap between powerful terminal-based applications and the accessibility of the web, enabling easy sharing and remote access.
key_features: Serve Textual applications in the browser
Generate public URLs for shared applications/terminals
Configuration via TOML file for multiple apps/terminals
Cross-platform compatibility (with planned Windows support for terminals)
primary_use_case: To make Textual applications and terminals accessible and shareable via web URLs, allowing users to run them in a browser without local installation.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical bridge extending from a classic computer terminal screen into a vibrant, open web browser window. On the terminal side, a complex, glowing circuit board represents a Textual application. As the bridge transforms the circuit board's energy into light particles, these particles flow across the bridge and materialize as a beautiful, interactive Textual app interface within the browser. Small, stylized code snippets float near the terminal, and subtle 'textual-web' branding is integrated into the bridge's structure. The overall mood is one of seamless connection and accessibility, rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, inviting color palette.

name: swarms
description: The Enterprise-Grade Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework. Website: https://swarms.ai
readme_summary: Swarms is an enterprise-grade, production-ready framework for orchestrating multi-agent systems. It provides scalable and adaptive architectures for sequential, concurrent, and hierarchical agent interactions, with backward compatibility and interoperability with various AI protocols.
key_features: Backward compatibility with leading agent frameworks
primary_use_case: Orchestrating and managing complex multi-agent AI systems in production environments.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor leading a symphony orchestra, where each musician represents an AI agent. The conductor, embodying the Swarms framework, uses a glowing baton to seamlessly coordinate the diverse instruments (agents) playing different parts (tasks). Sheet music on the stands shows flowing code and data streams, representing the inputs and outputs being processed. Subtle digital particles and network lines connect the conductor to each agent, illustrating the orchestration. The overall scene is a grand, modern concert hall, conveying professionalism and scale. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, vibrant color palette, emphasizing harmony and efficient collaboration.

name: imgcompress
description: Imgcompress is a self-hosted image processing toolbox that handles compression, format conversion, and AI background removal in a single web interface. It supports over 70 input formats (including PSD, HEIC, and RAW) and can output common formats or generate PDFs, all without sending files to external services.
readme_summary: ImgCompress is a self-hosted, privacy-focused image processing server that runs entirely within a Docker container. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for image compression, format conversion (supporting over 70 formats), and AI-powered background removal, all accessible via a web UI or CLI without sending data to external services.
key_features: Supports 70+ image formats (HEIC, PSD, AVIF, EPS, PDF, etc.)
Local AI background removal (no API keys or uploads)
Bulk compression with multi-core parallel processing
Format conversion (e.g., HEIC to WebP, PSD to JPG, images to PDF)
Per-file cropping with various ratio presets
Web UI and CLI for flexible usage
Single Docker container deployment with zero host dependencies
primary_use_case: To provide a self-hosted, all-in-one solution for local image processing, including compression, format conversion, and AI background removal, prioritizing user privacy and data ownership.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a private, cozy workshop, meticulously transforming raw, unrefined blocks of various image formats (like PSD, HEIC, RAW) into polished, perfectly shaped digital gems (like WebP, JPG, PDF). The artisan uses a specialized, glowing tool that subtly resembles a web interface, with small, abstract digital particles representing AI processing for background removal. The workshop is filled with shelves of neatly organized image files, emphasizing local storage. The overall mood is one of secure, efficient, and private craftsmanship. The scene should be rendered in a warm, inviting 3D isometric illustration style, with a focus on clear visual storytelling and subtle technological hints.
